proposed_widenings.name: passive_grant (class feature family)
proposed_widenings.justification: Elemental Affinity's resistance component is a permanent passive trait — no activation, no use count, no reset cadence. The only existing class feature family ('activation') mandates a UseCountResource and RestResetCadence, making it structurally incompatible with permanent passives. A 'passive_grant' family (or equivalent) is required to model features that are always-on from the level they are acquired.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Resistance to that damage type

proposed_widenings.name: grant_resistance (ClassFeatureEffect variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: The v4 atom 'grant_resistance' exists, but there is no ClassFeatureEffect variant that carries it. ClassFeatureEffect currently covers only 'grant_extra_action' and 'heal_hp'. Encoding resistance requires a new variant such as { kind: 'grant_resistance'; damageType: DamageType } in ClassFeatureEffect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You have Resistance to that damage type

proposed_widenings.name: modify_spell_damage_with_ability_mod (ClassFeatureEffect or OngoingOperation variant)
proposed_widenings.justification: The damage bonus is a conditional rider: when the sorcerer casts a spell dealing the chosen damage type, they may add their Charisma modifier to one damage roll. This is neither a fixed DiceDelta (DiceDelta has dice count + die size, not an ability score reference) nor any existing ClassFeatureEffect. A new variant is needed that expresses 'add ability_modifier(CHA) to one damage roll of spells matching damageType', conditioned on a spell_cast_window. The existing modify_roll_numeric atom uses DiceDelta which cannot reference an ability score.
proposed_widenings.evidence: when you cast a spell that deals damage of that type, you can add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of that spell

notes: The feature does not fit the 'activation' family at all — neither the resistance (permanent passive) nor the spell damage bonus (auto-trigger on spell cast, no use count) can be coerced into a UseCountResource + resetCadence shape without producing a deliberately false trace. The closest analog in the existing schema would be a species trait (permanent passive grant), but no species_trait family is modeled for class features either. Three widenings are needed: a new class-feature mechanics family for passive grants, a grant_resistance ClassFeatureEffect variant, and a new surface shape for ability-score-referenced conditional spell damage bonuses.
